news.title: Royal Navy’s Only Ice Patrol Ship Faces Uncertain Future After Defect
news.summary: The Royal Navy’s only dedicated ice patrol ship has been towed from Teesside to Devonport following a reported defect, raising questions about Britain’s ability to maintain its maritime presence in the polar regions as the government works toward a replacement.

news.title: Trump Touts Taiwan-Alaska LNG Deal Taipei Hasn’t Finalized
news.summary: President Donald Trump said Taiwan had agreed to buy 30% of the liquefied natural gas from a planned project in Alaska for 20 years, even as Taipei indicated that no binding commitments have been finalized.
